2019 Q1.bq: Q1 results were strong and somewhat better than our expectations from 90 days ago.

2024 Q2.bq: IDEX delivered against expectations in Q2 despite increasing macro uncertainty, with both adjusted EBITDA margin and adjusted EPS coming in slightly above our previous guidance.

2025 Q1.bq: As Eric mentioned, we outperformed our guidance for the first quarter across revenue, margin and adjusted earnings per share.

2025 Q2.gq: In the third quarter, we expect 2% to 3% organic revenue growth and adjusted EPS of $1.90 to $1.95.

2025 Q3.bq: And adjusted EBITDA margin and adjusted EPS came in higher than our forecast for the company overall.

2026 Q1.bq: And adjusted EPS came in significantly higher than our guided range in the first quarter.

2026 Q2.gq: For the third quarter of 2026, we expect 5% to 7% organic growth, adjusted EBITDA margin in the 27% to 27.5% range and adjusted EPS of $2.20 to $2.25.
2026 Q2.bq: In the second quarter of 2026, IDEX delivered strong results, which meaningfully exceeded our guidance for the quarter.

2026 Q3.bq: Third quarter results exceeded our guidance on every key measure.
